mode: Native PostgreSQL builtin comparisons of int4 and int8 under the explicit pg_catalog operator namespace or a lookup with pg_catalog first.
structure: A signed comparison retains the exact operator and ordered native field or literal operands. Each operand has its own int4 or int8 role. The pair identifies the builtin overload. The result is nullable Boolean.
conditions: Both operands must be resolved signed native fields or canonical signed literals. Every column, including one below a Boolean comparison in a projected result, must match its owning source occurrence and native kind. Analyzed comparisons admit unqualified builtin lookup with pg_catalog first and explicit pg_catalog qualification.
meaning: Evaluate the two signed values without narrowing. A NULL operand produces a NULL comparison result. WHERE and ON admit only true. A projected result retains false and NULL distinctly. Join null extension and duplicate matches retain the existing relational meaning.
sql: Emit the two typed operands in their original order with the qualified pg_catalog operator inside parentheses. Emit result aliases and apply the same submitted or positional column order.
